Notes: B = best baseline per task chosen on validation after the US 3.3 fix; F = frozen WavLM-base-plus (US 4.3 system per task); FT-base = US 5.1; FT-stab = US 5.3 rule-selected variants; MT-* = multi-task (SO762: 7 heads in one encoder, L2: 2 heads; GradNorm and regroup were run on SO762 only). Seeds: SO762 3, L2 FT 1 per fold, L2 MT 3 per fold. L2 FT-base / FT-stab here are the 1-seed Sprint 5 values; single- vs multi-task comparisons use the 3-seed Sprint 6 comparators (see section 3). MT-GN15 is the best-supported candidate with disclosure, not a rule-adopted fix.
